profile.role_note: On-field Havoc carry focused on Basic ATK DMG (spinning Heavy Attack in Budding/Blossom states).

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: An older limited 5-star Havoc DPS who has been heavily power-crept by newer carries. Skip unless you specifically love her playstyle or need a second Havoc DPS for Whimpering Wastes.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Red Spring + 5-piece Sun-sinking Eclipse in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Crownless (or Dreamless) in the main slot. Run Crit Rate/Crit DMG on the 4-cost, Havoc DMG Bonus on both 3-costs, and ATK% on the 1-costs, prioritizing Crit and Basic ATK DMG Bonus substats.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. ATK% and Basic ATK DMG Bonus that stacks on Concerto Energy consumption — tailor-made for her kit and best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star sword; solid all-around Crit Rate stat stick, the best F2P-friendly option per Prydwen.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: Other limited 5-star option; balances Crit and ATK but far below Red Spring for her.

ranked_weapons.name: Somnoire Anchor
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star/F2P option; also consider Commando of Conviction for its Intro Skill ATK bonus.

echo_sets.name: Sun-sinking Eclipse
echo_sets.note: Flat Havoc DMG Bonus plus stacks on Basic/Heavy Attack — effectively made for her kit. Crownless adds extra Havoc DMG Bonus; Dreamless is simpler direct damage.

echo_sets.name: Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: Large ATK% bonus that grows the longer she stays on-field; strong for her long rotations.

stat_priorities.note: Crit DMG or Crit Rate, whichever balances her 1:2 Crit ratio; she has no Crit Rate in her base kit.
Havoc DMG Bonus on both 3-costs; ATK% if your Havoc pieces have weak substats.
ATK% on both; her damage scales with ATK.

build.energy_regen_target: No fixed breakpoint cited in current guides; a moderate amount so she can cast Liberation comfortably — prioritize Crit and Basic ATK DMG Bonus first.

teams.name: Premium: Camellya + Sanhua + Shorekeeper

members.name: Camellya
members.note: The on-field carry; enter Blossom state, spin with the enhanced Heavy Attack, and end with Ephemeral.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Her Outro grants Camellya a huge 38% Basic ATK DMG buff — essentially mandatory; use Sanhua right before Camellya.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and hands out broad Crit buffs; deploys Stellarealm before Camellya takes the field.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm and heals, Sanhua does her quick Outro-buffed combo, then Camellya takes a long on-field window: stack Crimson Bud, cast Ephemeral, and spin through Blossom state.

teams.name: Budget: Camellya + Sanhua + Verina

members.name: Camellya
members.note: The on-field carry; same Blossom-state spin rotation.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Free 4-star; her Outro's Basic ATK DMG buff is the core of every Camellya team.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Simple team-wide heals and ATK buffs; not as strong as Shorekeeper but free and easy to slot in.

teams.rotation: Verina buffs and heals first, Sanhua Outro into Camellya, then Camellya's full on-field window. Ensure both supports cast Liberation before Camellya enters so buffs are active.

teams.name: Alternative: Camellya + Roccia + Shorekeeper

members.name: Camellya
members.note: The on-field carry; Havoc resonance means her damage stacks with Roccia's team support.

members.name: Roccia
members.note: 5-star Havoc sub-DPS who amplifies Havoc teams; an upgrade over Sanhua for players who pulled her.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit buffs and healing with minimal field time.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Roccia runs her quick support combo, then Camellya takes the extended on-field Havoc window.

tier_badge.label: Solid performer
tier_badge.note: Sources disagree: recent lists place her at A (Beebom 3.7), B, C, or D (GachaGo Oct 2026); power creep and her long rotation have pushed the former meta carry down.
